hyperAccuracyReceipt.nonCopyBoundary: Do not copy exact source visuals, brand names, color identity, imagery, icon systems, decorative geometry, or section order.

commercialPurpose: Resolve buyer uncertainty with a split FAQ area that separates question navigation from answer cards.
purposeLayer: FAQ section makes many objections usable by placing clickable question pills on one side and answer summaries on the other.
anatomyLayer: Left colored panel with stacked question buttons, right answer cards, section title, optional scroll cue, and light grid background.
hierarchyLayer: Section title first, question list second, answer cards third, scroll cue last.
gridRhythmLayer: Two-column FAQ split with dense interactive question stack and calmer answer cards.
densityLimitLayer: Use 5-8 useful objections, split into a question rail and 3-4 visible answer cards or expandable responses.
originalityLayer: Learn split FAQ navigation; transform colors, interaction state, answer card shape, and objection grouping.
usageRuleLayer: Use for SaaS, business platforms, membership, service, ecommerce, and template FAQ sections where questions need organization.
layoutGesture: split FAQ with colored question rail and white answer cards
sectionSilhouette: left stacked question panel paired with right answer card column
compositionTension: dense question controls balance calmer explanatory cards
focalPath: section title to question rail to selected answer cards to scroll cue
negativeSpaceShape: light grid whitespace around a dense colored FAQ block
depthLayering: colored panel layer, white answer cards, small icon controls
moduleScaleVariation: many small question buttons beside larger answer cards
breakoutBehavior: contained two-column FAQ, no full-bleed slab
antiCopyBoundary: Do not copy exact blue panel color, question wording, icon buttons, grid decoration, or card copy.
